learning_outcomes.text: After the course the student shall be able to describe basic concepts and theories within the area of industrial management.
The student shall be able to use these concepts and theories in limited analysis of an organization.
The student shall be able to present organizational analysis, written and orally.

syllabus_topics: Principles for organisational design and co-ordination
assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
bibliography: Jacobsen, Dag Ingvar, Thorsvik, Jan, Sandin, Gunnar, Larson, Per, (2021) Hur moderna organisationer fungerar. Femte upplagan Lund : Studentlitteratur, [2021] ISBN: 9789144150956
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
